`2026-08-26.md` uses the day the meeting was held. The index notes that it was moved from 25 August, and that 3 November is the last meeting of the year. The project `README.md` now points at `notes/index.md`.

What I checked:

- SHA-1 checksums and line counts of all seven minutes files match the copies taken before the rename, so the text is unchanged.
- Each filename date matches the date in that file’s heading.
- None of the old filenames remain.
- Every link in `notes/index.md` points at a file in that folder, in date order.
- `members.csv` is still 25 lines and was not edited.
